title: New whatsapp user
description: The user will get guidance on how to login to whatsapp as a new user

steps.instruction:
Step 1: Turn ON mobile data on your smartphone.

Step 2: Open the WhatsApp application on your phone.

Step 3: Tap “Agree and Continue.”

Step 4: Enter your mobile phone number.

Step 5: Tap Next.

Step 6: You will receive a 6-digit verification code (OTP) by SMS.

Step 7: Enter the verification code in WhatsApp.

Step 8: Type your name and optionally add a profile photo.

Step 9: Tap Next / Continue.

Step 10: WhatsApp will open, and you can now send messages, photos, and make calls to your contacts.
